objections.text: The hand-derived 'old password differs only in case' case already tests binary hash comparison with a stored hash that actually matches the lowercase password. A02 supplies unrelated bytes (00ff10), so either case variant is refused and this is a weaker duplicate of that fixed case.

The stored hash aa is not SHA-256 over the UTF-16LE bytes of 'pwamy'. The password check therefore fails before any UPDATE, so the case cannot test its claim that only PersonID 2 changes while PersonID 3 stays untouched.

The stored hash 00ff10 is not the hash of 'pw' plus FullName 'x'. The call is refused, so HashedPassword does not become NULL as the label says. The hand-derived NULL-new-password case already reaches that assignment with a matching old-password hash.

The label says the supplied old password is correct, but the stored bytes 00ff10 are not the hash of 'pwroot'. The fixed case for PersonID 1 supplies a genuinely matching hash and already tests the template-person refusal.

The stored hash 00ff10 is not the hash of 'pw' plus the trailing-space FullName 'Ab '. The procedure raises before computing or storing the new hash, so removing the trailing space from the hashed full name would not change this case's outcome.
